source_name: NAPR — National Agency of Public Registry (e-registry / enreg)
organization: National Agency of Public Registry (NAPR), Ministry of Justice of Georgia
notes: Authoritative Georgian company registry. The public e-registry search (enreg.reestri.gov.ge/main.php, c=app) is CAPTCHA-gated (captcha_validator_field) and also offers a login (auth_username/auth_password). Free company extracts (amonaweri) are available AFTER solving the CAPTCHA — no open bulk or free API. api.napr.gov.ge returns 'Access Denied'. reestri.gov.ge 301-redirects to napr.gov.ge. Key = 9-digit identification code (saidentifikacio kodi). Directors/partners are personal data. Not bypassed; field model from public knowledge.

source_name: SARAS Reporting Portal (reportal.ge) — public financial statements
organization: Service for Accounting, Reporting and Auditing Supervision (SARAS), Ministry of Finance of Georgia
notes: Official public portal where Georgian entities required to report (public-interest, large/medium) file annual financial statements + management reports, freely viewable. Browser-public search by identification code or name. Automation is gated: the simple search POST (/en/Base/Search) requires an __RequestVerificationToken; the detailed search is a GET form to /en/Reports/List with params (orgName, year, legalFormId, naceCodes) but guessed URLs returned 404. Genuinely open financial-statements source via browser; needs token/session handling for automation. Key = 9-digit identification code.

organization: Georgian Stock Exchange (GSE / JSC Georgian Stock Exchange)
notes: Georgian Stock Exchange securities list. Browser-public; the securities page exposes Georgian ISINs (32 distinct GExxxxxxxxxx codes observed, e.g. GE1100000029, GE2700604186). Listed companies only; small market. No clean open JSON API found; HTML page only.
